## About
Mario's Body Shop is on Gratiot Avenue in Clinton Township. We handle auto collision repair, auto glass repair and windshield repair, and we know how much you need your car in everyday life, so we work to get it done quickly and efficiently.
Our mechanics are ASE and I-CAR Gold certified, and we are a DuPont quality assurance service provider. You'll get a free estimate before we start, so you won't be surprised when you get the bill. Free pickup and delivery are available too.
Customers know us by name. Reviewers mention Luigi and Shelle, and one pointed out that yes, there is a Mario and a Luigi. We're rated 4.7 from 345 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto Collision Repair: If you have been in an accident, bring your car to our shop for affordable collision repairs.
- Auto Glass Repair: Top-grade auto glass repair for your vehicle.
- Windshield Repair: Windshield repairs done right, right here in Clinton Township.
- Free Estimates: Know what you'll pay before we start, so you won't be surprised when you get the bill. (FREE)
- Pickup and delivery: We can pick up your vehicle and bring it back to you.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us or stop by and we'll give you a free estimate, so you know what to expect before the work starts.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're available on Saturdays by appointment.

Q: Can you pick up my car?
A: Yes, pickup and delivery are available. Give us a call to set it up.

Q: Are your mechanics certified?
A: Yes. Our mechanics are ASE and I-CAR Gold certified, and we are a DuPont quality assurance service provider.
